mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion_pairing_session (promotion_channel_id, channel_name, owner_user_id, session_token_hash, phone, protocol_account_id, status, expires_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{promotionChannelId}, #{channelName}, #{ownerUserId}, #{sessionTokenHash}, #{phone}, #{protocolAccountId}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.sql: id, tenant_id AS tenantId, promotion_channel_id AS promotionChannelId, channel_name AS channelName, owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, session_token_hash AS sessionTokenHash, phone, protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, pairing_id AS pairingId, pairing_code AS pairingCode, status, proxy_id AS proxyId, proxy_session_id AS proxySessionId, proxy_region AS proxyRegion, proxy_source AS proxySource, account_id AS accountId, expires_at AS expiresAt, error_code AS errorCode, error_message AS errorMessage, completed_at AS completedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.update: UPDATE promotion_pairing_session SET proxy_id = #{proxyId}, proxy_session_id = #{proxySessionId}, proxy_region = #{proxyRegion}, proxy_source = #{proxySource}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 AND proxy_id IS NULL

UPDATE promotion_pairing_session SET status = #{status}, pairing_code = NULL, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status IN (1, 2, 3)
